fields.description: Inaura combines branded homes and a hotel in Downtown Dubai. Apartments, sky villas and a penthouse sit within MVRDV’s tower design, with an elevated lounge and spaces for fitness, work and relaxation.

sources.label: Inaura: developer residences and payment plan
Inaura: MVRDV project and tower design
Inaura: original 29-page residence plans, broker mirror

overview: Arada’s January 2026 launch describes 114 branded homes alongside a hotel: one- to four-bedroom apartments, two five-bedroom duplexes and a six-bedroom triplex.
MVRDV designed the tower around an elevated orb-shaped social space. Fitness, spa facilities and hotel services form part of the residential setting.
research.locationNote: At the edge of Downtown Dubai, close to Business Bay. Developer journey times are estimates, not guaranteed travel times.
research.priceNote: The developer advertises AED 3,599,000 for a Lumen one-bedroom residence. Property Finder marks its project selection sold out; this guide is not a confirmed available-unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Current developer terms: 10% down, 40% during construction and 50% on handover. Obtain dated instalments and fees for the selected home; no original signed payment calendar was available.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder gives June 2030; the reviewed developer landing page and launch release do not publish a completion date. Treat this as a secondary forecast, not a confirmed handover.
